thread:
lena: Quick heads-up: I spotted a problematic 429 example in the error reference while porting SDK snippets. The current example shows a tight retry loop that can hammer the API.

matt: which doc?

lena: docs/error-reference/429-behavior.md, section 'quick retry'. We should swap to Retry-After-aware backoff + jitter and mention fallbacks.

ali: agreed. The curl sample also ignores Retry-After and our X-Redwood-Retry hint. I can draft a compact repro and snippets.

sophie: I'll prepare two tiny examples: one curl shell that reads Retry-After, one python SDK pseudocode showing prefer-Retry-After -> X-Redwood-Retry -> exponential+jitter. Keep both <15 lines.

lena: include a short repro script for QA (dev-only) so they can simulate a surge and see Retry-After pop up.

ali: example repro we used in sandbox:
```
for i in range(40):
  r = requests.post(API, json={"input":"spam"})
  if r.status_code==429:
    print('RA', r.headers.get('Retry-After'))
  time.sleep(0.15)
```

matt: QA saw similar. Also add guidance: if Retry-After is missing or long, prefer trimming context or switching to a smaller model rather than tight retries. Also advise a circuit-breaker when clouds surge.

sophie: noted. I'll add a one-liner to parse Retry-After in shell (annotated as brittle): `sleep $(curl -sI ... | grep -i Retry-After | awk '{print $2}')` and explain caveats.

ali: small nit: normalize Retry-After values <1s to 1s before sleeping, and add random jitter +/- 30%.

lena: also add streaming guidance: "If a stream is interrupted by 429, reconnect with backoff and reattach partial context when safe; avoid resending full prompt blindly."

matt: good. For docs workflow: target docs/error-reference/429-behavior.md, label PR with '429-playbook' and 'needs-approval'. Tag reviewers @ali and @lena.

sophie: opening PR now with python/js/go SDK snippets in /sdk-snippets/. Title: "429 playbook: Retry-After + graceful fallback examples".

docs-bot: PR created by sophie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/874 29 playbook: Retry-After + graceful fallback examples

sophie: fixed, pushed. deploy-bot queued docs preview build.
